task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Hold the tea-box with rectangular edges with one hand, grab the scanner with curved handle with the other, and scan the tea-box with rectangular edges.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，一手握住矩形边缘的茶叶盒，另一只手抓住弧形手柄的扫描仪，对矩形边缘的茶叶盒进行扫描。
